content:
The lower half of the disk forms a straight angle, so the central angles there add to \(180^\circ\).

If the shaded sector has central angle \(\theta\), then
\[
30^\circ+\theta+65^\circ+40^\circ=180^\circ.
\]
Thus
\[
\theta=180^\circ-30^\circ-65^\circ-40^\circ=45^\circ.
\]

Since the point is chosen uniformly from the disk, the probability is proportional to area:
\[
\frac{\text{area of shaded sector}}{\text{area of disk}}
=\frac{45^\circ}{360^\circ}
=\frac18.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac18}
\]
